responsibility: Collects Polonius input facts from a fully built BIR function. This file walks BIR statements, places, loans, scopes, CFG structure, and bound regions to populate the Polonius::Facts relations for issued and killed loans, subset/outlives constraints, variable uses/definitions/drops, path parentage, assignments, moves, accesses, and universal-region placeholders, including normalization of deref/field/index paths and application of variance-based lifetime constraints from Rust types so the borrow-checker engine receives a complete per-function fact database.
